name: Student signing requirement
text: It must be signed by all students.

name: Definition of Student
text: “Student” includes adult and minor students, unless indicated otherwise.

name: Minor student parent signature
text: If the student is a minor (under 18 years of age in most states) at least one parent or guardian (referred to below as “Parent”) must also sign, as evidence of Parent's acknowledgment and agreement to the following, on Parent’s behalf and on behalf of the minor student.

name: Legal competency determination
text: Student and parent must determine the age of legal competency to sign contracts, in thé state of the student's residence.

name: Activities and Risks — program activities
text: Activities and Risks T understand that National Outdoor Leadership School (NOLS) programs live, camp and travel out of doors. Activities vary from program to program and include, among others, hiking and backpacking through mountainous and other terrain, mountaineering and climbing on rock cliffs, steep snow, ice or glaciers, whitewater kayaking, rafting and canoeing, sea kayaking, ocean sailing, horsepacking, skiing, snowboarding, fishing, and caving.

name: Acknowledgment of activity risks
text: I further understand and acknowledge that the activities of the programs have risks, including certain risks which are inherent.

name: Definition of inherent risks
text: Inherent risks are those which cannot be eliminated without destroying the unique character of the activities.

name: Consequences of inherent risks
text: The same elements. that contribute to the unique character of these activities can cause loss or damage to equipment, accidental injury, illness, or, in extreme cases, permanent trauma, disability or death.

name: Strenuous activities risk
text: NOLS activities may be strenuous, physically and emotionally.

name: Remote locations risk
text: NOLS programs usually occur in remote places.

name: Public lands and third-party acts risk
text: They occur on lands open to the public, and exposed to the acts of persons not associated with NOLS,

name: Distance from medical facilities
text: The remote locations may be many days from medical facilities.

name: Delayed communication, transportation, and care
text: Communication and transportation are difficult and evacuations and medical care may be significantly delayed.

name: Equipment failure risk
text: Equipment may fail or malfunction.

name: Cooking risks
text: Meals are prepared over gas stoves and open fires.

name: Water disinfection
text: Water may require disinfection before use.

name: Food allergy contact risk
text: Students with food allergies or sensitivities may come in contact with offending food ‘types.

name: Camping risks
text: Camping risks include burns and cuts, sprains, strains and other injuries from slips, falls, and lifting, and illnesses including diarrhea and flu-like illness.

name: Travel methods and terrain
text: Travel is by vehicle, raft, canoe, kayak, sail and other boats, horse, aircraft, train, skis, snowboards, on foot and by other means, over improved and unimproved roads, rugged trails and off-trail terrain, including boulder fields, downed timber, rivers, rapids, river crossings, high mountain passes, snow and ice, steep slopes, slippery rocks, steep or crevassed glaciers, ocean tides, currents, waves, surf and reefs.

name: Travel risks
text: euegete ogShEs include collision, falling, capsizing, drowning, becoming lost, and other risks usually associated with such travel, including environmental risks.

name: Environmental hazards
text: Environmental risks and hazards include flowing, deep and/or cold water; insects, snakes, predators, and large animals; falling and rolling rock; lightning, avalanches, flash floods, falling timber and forces of nature, including weather which may change to extreme conditions.

name: Environmental injuries and illnesses
text: Possible injuries and illnesses include hypothermia, frostbite, immersion foot, high altitude illnesses, sunburn, heatstroke, dehydration, and other mild or serious conditions.

name: Decision-making limitations
text: Decisions made by the instructors, other staff (including volunteers), contractors and students will be based on a variety of perceptions and evaluations, which by their nature are imprecise and subject to errors in judgment.

name: Subjects of possible misjudgments
text: Misjudgments may pertain to, among other things, a student's capabilities, environment, terrain, water and weather conditions, natural hazards, routes and medical conditions.

name: Unsupervised student travel
text: On most NOLS courses, small groups of students travel at times during the day, and possibly for several days and nights, without instructors.

name: Student free time
text: NOLS students, including minors, may have “free” time before, during and after their course. NOLS

name: No responsibility before and after course
text: NOLS has no responsibility for students during their free time before and after their course.

name: Staff participation in free-time activities
text: NOLS staff may from time to time provide assistance or even accompany students in these free time activities, but in doing so, they are acting as private individuals, and NOLS is not responsible for their conduct.

name: No continual monitoring
text: During the course NOLS cannot continually monitor the behavior and activities of students

name: Student responsibility during course
text: and students must accept responsibility for themselves and others whether or not under the direct supervision of NOLS staff.

name: Foreign-country exposures
text: NOLS programs in foreign countries may be exposed to laws, legal systems, customs and behaviors, and to animals, diseases and infections, not common to the United States.

name: Foreign-country travel and security risks
text: In addition, these programs may be subject to dangerous road travel, political unrest, riots, demonstrations, banditry, terrorism and other criminal conduct, including drug related activities.

name: Foreign-country field practices
text: NOLS field practices in foreign countries are generally consistent with customs and standards used in the United States regarding such practices.

name: Instructional nature of activities
text: NOLS activities are instructional in nature and students will be challenged to expand their skills and judgment.

name: Use of private contractors
text: NOLS may from time to time use the services of private contractors for certain tasks, including, for example, transportation.

name: Contractor responsibility disclaimer
text: NOLS is not responsible for the acts or omissions of such contractors.

name: Acknowledgment of course information
text: I have read and understand the general information about NOLS and its courses in the NOLS Catalog of Courses and/or at the NOLS website.

name: Included course information
text: This information includes NOLS’ Admission Policies, the statement titled Risk Management at NOLS, the NOLS Enrollment Packet and other material provided by NOLS describing or related to my program.

name: Availability of staff explanations
text: The staff of NOLS has been available to more fully explain the nature and physical demands of the activities in which I will be engaged, and certain inherent and other risks of my NOLS activity.

name: Acknowledgment and Assumption — incomplete risk description
text: Acknowledgment and Assumption of Inherent and Other Risks I understand and acknowledge that the description above (“Activities and Risks”) of the inherent risks of NOLS’ activities is not complete and that other, including unknown or unanticipated, risks, inherent and otherwise, may result in property loss, injury, illness or death.

name: Voluntary participation acknowledgment
text: T acknowledge that my participation in this NOLS program is purely voluntary, and I wish to participate in spite of and with knowledge of the inherent and other risks involved.

name: Assumption of inherent risks
text: I acknowledge and assume the inherent risks described above and all other inherent risks of my NOLS activity.

name: Assumption of all risks
text: In addition, except with respect to an injury or other loss which occurs on lands whose rules or regulations prohibit my doing so as a matter of law, I expressly assume ALL risks of enrolling and participating in a NOLS program, inherent or otherwise, and whether or not described above.

name: Agreements of Release and Indemnity — release
text: Agreements of Release and Indemnity If Tam an adult student, or the parent of a minor student I agree, for myself and on behalf of the minor student for whom I sign, as follows: I hereby release, hold harmless and agree not to sue NOLS, its officers, trustees, agents, and staff including employees, volunteers and interns (“Released Parties”), with respect to any and all claims of loss or damage to person or property by reason of injury, disability, death, or otherwise, suffered by me or by a minor student for whom I sign, arising in whole or part from my, or the minor student’s, enrollment or participation in an activity of NOLS.

name: Indemnity
text: I agree further to indemnify. (7indemnify” meaning to defend, and to pay or reimburse, including costs and attorney's fees) Released Parties against any claim by a member of my, or the minor student's, family, a rescuer, another student, or any other person, arising in whole or part from an injury or other loss suffered by me or caused by me, or by the minor Student, in connection with my, or the minor student's, enrollment or participation in an activity of NOLS.

name: Negligence scope and exclusion
text: These agreements of Release and Indemnity include claims of negligence of a Released Party, but not of gross negligence or intentionally wrongful conduct.

name: Fullest lawful enforcement
text: They are intended to be enforced to the fullest extent permitted by law.

name: Lands-based release and indemnity exception
text: These agreements of release and indemnity are of no force or effect with respect to an injury or other loss which occurs on lands whose rules or regulations prohibit such agreements as a matter of law.

name: Other Provisions — health verification and disclosure
text: Other Provisions if I am an adult student or the parent of a minor student I further agree, for myself and on behalf of the minor student for whom I sign, as follows: I have verified with my or the minor student’s physician and other medical professionals, or otherwise satisfied NOLS, that I, or the minor student, have no past or current physical or psychological condition that might affect my, or the minor's, participation in the program, other than as described on the health form submitted to NOLS.

name: Fitness to participate
text: I am, or the minor is, able to participate without causing harm to myself, or to himself or herself, or to others.

name: Accuracy of medical information
text: The medical information given to NOLS is accurate and all pertinent medical conditions have been disclosed.

name: Updated medical disclosure
text: Prior to the commencement of the course, NOLS will be informed of any medical condition that has not been previously disclosed.

name: Admission not medical-management representation
text: 1 understand that NOLS’ admission of me or the minor student to the course is not intended as a representation that NOLS staff will be able to manage successfully a medical event or emergency related to a disclosed, or undisclosed, medical condition.

name: Responsibility for course suitability
text: The responsibility for determining a student's suitability for a course is not NOLS’ but, rather, the student’s, guided by family and her or his physician.

name: Right to refuse or remove student
text: NOLS reserves the right to refuse admission or remove a student from a course for any reason it deems in the best interests of the student or the school.

name: Emergency medical authorization
text: NOLS is authorized to obtain or provide emergency hospitalization, surgical or other medical care for me, or for the minor student.

name: NOLS staff emergency care
text: I understand that situations may arise in which thirdparty medical care is not available and which require NOLS staff to provide first aid and possibly more advanced procedures, employing wilderness first responder training.

name: Medical protocols
text: Such care will be provided under the guidance of the NOLS Physician Advisor by way of NOLS’ written Medical Protocols.

name: Medical information exchange
text: Any third-party medical care provider is authorized to exchange pertinent medical information with NOLS.

name: Medical and evacuation costs
text: Costs reasonably associated with medical services, including evacuation, shall be borne by me.

name: Sharing contact information
text: NOLS may share my or the minor student's contact information with other NOLS students or graduates and/or with environmental organizations or strategic partners in which NOLS graduates may be interested;

name: Promotional use
text: and NOLS may use my or the minor student’s name, contact information and photo or other image in promotional materials and press releases.

name: Responsibility for damage
text: I agree to be responsible for any damage I, or the minor student, may cause to NOLS facilities or gear.

name: Personal belongings disclaimer
text: NOLS is not responsible for loss, theft or damage to a student's personal belongings stored at NOLS facilities.

name: Governing law
text: Any dispute between me, or the minor student, and NOLS will be governed by the substantive * laws (not including the laws which might apply the laws of another jurisdiction) of the State of Wyoming,

name: Wyoming forum
text: and any mediation or suit shal] occur or be filed only in the State of Wyoming.

name: Severability
text: If any part of this agreement is found by a court or other appropriate authority to be invalid, the remainder of the agreement nevertheless will be in full force and effect.

name: Acknowledgment, agreement, and binding effect
text: THE STUDENT AND THE PARENT(S) OR GUARDIAN OF A MINOR STUDENT HAVE READ THIS PAGE AND THE PREVIOUS 3 PAGES OF THIS DOCUMENT AND UNDERSTAND AND VOLUNTARILY AGREE TO ITS TERMS, WHICH SHALL BE BINDING UPON THEM, THEIR HEIRS, ESTATE, EXECUTORS AND ADMINISTRATORS.

name: Written modification requirement
text: THE AGREEMENT MAY BE MODIFIED ONLY IN WRITING.
